Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a hands-on, technical candidate to be the driver of our production data systemization and simulation efforts. As a member of the team, this candidate will operate at the intersection of manufacturing operations, data, and strategy and will be responsible for scoping, conceptualizing, and implementing high impact tools that drive factory operations.

You will act as a translator between functional groups and leadership, partnering with cross functional stakeholders (Factory Data Acquisition, Data, Software, and Operations) to turn messy systems data into actionable insight. This is an applied, hands-on role that combines data architecture, analysis, and system design to make our operations measurable, predictable, and optimizable.

AARP is the nation's largest nonprofit, nonpartisan organization dedicated to empowering people 50 and older to choose how they live as they age. AARP observes Mondays and Fridays as remote workdays, except for essential functions. Remote work can only be done within the United States and its territories.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst F/H
jobs.description:
Devoteam a ouvert ses portes à Montpellier. En rejoignant cette équipe, vous contribuez à l’essor d’une nouvelle agence en pleine croissance et participez activement au développement de nos activités dans la région.

Rejoignez-nous et écrivons ensemble l’histoire de Devoteam à Montpellier !

Data Driven a pour ambition d’aider ses clients à transformer la valeur de leurs données en succès durable. Nous tirons parti à la fois de notre expertise sur les plateformes technologiques les plus innovantes et de notre connaissance métier avec la meilleure combinaison d’experts pour accompagner nos clients dans leur quête d’agilité, de compétitivité et de croissance durable.

Description Du Poste

Rejoignez notre équipe sur des projets impactant, dans un environnement propice à la formation et au développement continu. Nos clients sont des grands comptes de secteurs d'activité variés (Industrie, Transport, Logistique, Banque, Assurance, Energie...).

Au cœur de grands projets de transformation, vous êtes le pont entre les équipes métiers et techniques, en traduisant les besoins business en solutions data concrètes et innovantes.

Vos missions :

Analyser les processus métiers pour identifier les opportunités d'amélioration par la valorisation des données.
Recueillir, challenger et formaliser les exigences fonctionnelles et techniques pour les projets data & analytics.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques (Data Engineers, Data Scientists) pour concevoir des solutions adaptées et performantes.
Participer à la modélisation des données et à la conception des flux de données.
Accompagner les utilisateurs finaux dans la prise en main et l'adoption des outils d'analyse (BI, reportings).

Qualifications

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur (Bac+5) et justifiez d'au moins 4 ans d'expérience
en analyse métier ou en conseil, avec une forte composante data. Vous possédez d'excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et un fort sens du relationnel. La maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable.

Compétences attendues :

Tracking & Web Analytics : Maîtrise incontournable des outils d'analyse web (Piano Analytics) et de tag management (Tag Commander) pour le suivi et l'analyse fine des parcours digitaux.
Data Visualisation & UX/UI : Maîtrise des outils de restitution (Power BI, MicroStrategy ou Tableau) et conception de dashboards orientés UX/UI pour une lecture optimale des indicateurs.
Manipulation de données : Solide connaissance des bases de données et maîtrise du langage SQL pour l'extraction et l'analyse. Rigueur absolue exigée, la mission impliquant un accès à des données à caractère personnel.
Vision Métier & Soft Skills : Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers et à traduire les besoins en indicateurs de performance (KPIs) pertinents. Doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel, de pédagogie et force de proposition, vous collaborerez en étroite synergie avec le Business, les Product Owners (PO) et les Business Analysts (BA).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

Nous sommes une AI-Driven Company, partenaire des plus grands partenaires technologiques (Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow,…) et composée d'un important collectif d'experts (50 tribus d'expertise). Avec 75% de nos collaborateurs certifiés dont 100 % sur la GenAI, Devoteam s'impose comme une Learning Company, où l’apprentissage continu est au cœur de notre ADN.

Informations supplémentaires

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement chez Devoteam ? Il comporte 2 à 3 entretiens :

Talent Acquisition Interview : l'objectif est de faire le point sur vos compétences, votre niveau d'anglais et de valider vos éléments de motivation
Tech & Business Interview : cet entretien vise à approfondir vos compétences techniques et à vérifier leur adéquation avec nos besoins lors d'un échange avec un expert métier
Leadership Interview : il permet d'évaluer votre potentiel, vos ambitions et d'envisager votre évolution au sein de Devoteam.

Nous privilégions au moins un entretien en présentiel. Une prise de référence est demandée et, selon votre profil, des tests (techniques, anglais, personnalité...) peuvent vous être adressés.

Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous faisons parvenir une proposition présentant les conditions d'embauche. En cas d'acceptation, le contrat de travail est formalisé.

Le Groupe Devoteam oeuvre pour l'égalité des chances, pour la promotion de ses collaboratrices et de ses collaborateurs au mérite et lutte activement contre toute forme de discrimination. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité contribue à la créativité, au dynamisme et à l'excellence de notre organisation. Chaque candidature est donc considérée indépendamment de tout critère discriminatoire.

jobs.title: Corporate Audit Integrated Data Analyst, Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for Integrated Audit Data Analyst, Officer to join the Corporate Audit Team. Corporate Audit conducts internal audits of all of State Street’s business lines, including Investment Services, Global Markets, Global Advisors, and corporate functions. In this position, you will play a data specialist role as part of dynamic and cross functional teams responsible for the execution of individual audit engagements. In this role, you will work under the direction of audit project lead to support the execution of the audit through the use of data analytics. This will require both audit skills, as well as an understanding of data analytics, to allow the auditor to interface with business partners, execute control design assessments and operational effectiveness testing, developing audit test conclusions and drafting summary observations. The Integrated Data Analyst will partner with both the Data Analytics team and the business audit team to design data-driven test approaches in audit projects. You will also work with the business audit teams to analyze the results of data analytic control tests to identify potential control weaknesses. You will also play a role in the onboarding and coaching of junior staff and support various departmental initiatives.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability; regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role, you will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As an Integrated Data Analyst, Officer you will:

Leverage data analytics skills to perform audit work in line with the Division’s risk-based methodology and the Institute of Internal Auditor’s standards to identify and understand risk; determine control objectives; and evaluate whether controls sufficiently address identified risks through various data analysis techniques.
Serve as a conduit between the Business Audit Team and the Data Analytics Team to ensure an understanding of business processes and data analytics capabilities, to drive better data analytics outcomes, including the establishment of repeatable data analytics/continuous auditing use cases.
Obtain and analyze evidentiary data as a basis for drafting informed and objective opinions on the adequacy and effectives of controls under review. This may include previously identified data analytics approaches; however, the Integrated Data Analyst will be expected to leverage their data analytics knowledge to partner with the central Data Analytics team and the business audit team to design enhanced analytics approaches.
Draft audit issues that clearly outline the identified issue and underlying root cause, using data analysis to support conclusions and inferences regarding risk of findings.
Review corrective actions taken by management to improve deficient conditions.
Escalate potential issues / obstacles to audit management along with proposed solutions.
Develop and maintain understanding of internal State Street products and processes, relevant industry and regulatory topics, and data analytics best practices.
Develop an understanding of State Street data constructs, systems, and processes, to better position the team for more effective data analytics-based auditing.
Develop relationships with audit clients and business partners across the lines of defense; serve as the primary audit contact for assigned area in individual audit engagements.
Contribute to change initiatives through active participation in working groups and adoption of practices in day-to-day responsibilities.
Share successes and challenges with peer Integrated Data Analysts and the Data Analytics Team to increase the future success of the Data Analytics program.
Assist in the onboarding of audit staff, and the coaching of business auditors in the use of data analytics.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

The ability to operate in a complex, non-routine and fast-paced environment that requires working independently and as part of a team.
Strong technical ability in AI and data science.
Strong technical ability in data analysis and control testing
Ability to clearly demonstrate proficiency in evaluating business processes, identifying inherent risk and testing associated internal controls.
A high degree of professionalism and proficient organizational, analytical, problem solving and project management skills.
Excellent communication (written and verbal), interpersonal and presentation skills
Proven ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Public Accounting, Internal Auditing or financial services experience.
Professional experience and/or a degree related to the use of data science and analytics
Technical data analytics skills, including the use of SQL, Python, R, Tableau, PowerBI, Alteryx, and other analytics and automation tools.
Technical expertise in AI, data science and machine learning models is a big plus.
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in finance, accounting, computer science or related fields.
Advanced degree or certification (CFA, FRM, CPA, CIA) preferrable.
Technical expertise with Databricks is preferrable.
Experience in auditing information technology general controls.

Additional Requirements

While majority of the time you will work from your primary location, some domestic and international travel may be required to a variety of locations where State Street operates.

Are you the right candidate? Yes!

We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

About State Street

What we do.
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

Work, Live and Grow.
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.

Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Analyze user engagement and retention patterns using behavioral data in BigQuery, applying lightweight statistical models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis) to identify drivers of conversion, churn risk, and lifetime value Develop and operationalize audience segments using clustering and propensity modeling (e.g., k-means, logistic regression) within dbt/SQL workflows, enabling targeted activation and personalization across marketing and product channels
Help business users effectively explore data using AI tools - translate stakeholder questions into structured data models and AI-ready datasets, ensuring alignment with standardized metrics and business logic Build and maintain AI-enabled self-service analytics workflows (e.g., NLQ in Hex using BigQuery/dbt models) that allow stakeholders to answer business questions without using SQL
Develop and document curated datasets and semantic definitions that improve the accuracy and usability of AI-generated insights
Iterate on data models and documentation based on stakeholder usage patterns and feedback from AI-assisted analysis
Consult with Product Managers on digital product performance measurement
Partner with engineering to ensure AI tools are properly connected to governed data sources (e.g., dbt models in BigQuery), improving trust and adoption
Present new capabilities and analyses to senior leaders and less technical audiences inside The Inquirer, and serve as a trusted partner for stakeholder outreach
Contribute to an inclusive and positive work environment

5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and data manipulation.
Strong background in A/B testing methodologies and experimentation.
Experience with event tracking and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics).
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to consult with stakeholders and translate complex data into actionable insights.
Ability to work cross-functionally and influence product roadmaps through data.

About Us.

The Philadelphia Inquirer is the media brand of record in Philadelphia and the region, and the largest news media organization in the state of Pennsylvania. Project Planning & Execution:

Optimize team utilization across multiple concurrent implementations.

Experience working with SaaS platforms, enterprise software, or custom software rollouts.

Amazon is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to support the Amazon Logistics North America (AMZL NA) Engineering team, part of Amazon's Last Mile organization. The Last Mile team helps get customer packages from delivery stations to a customer's doorstep.

This is a unique opportunity to own high-impact engineering programs and mechanisms that advance the intelligence and reliability of our last mile business. We are looking for an individual who has experience creating scalable, data-driven solutions to complex reliability and engineering problems. In this role, you will be responsible for driving engineering program governance, compliance reporting, data analytics, and documentation systems that enable leadership visibility, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence across a portfolio of automation and electrical infrastructure projects.

You will build and maintain the mechanisms that keep our engineering organization running at the highest standard—from automated dashboards and compliance reporting to documentation platforms and stakeholder coordination. You will partner with field engineers, electrical contractors, supply chain teams, and operations leaders to deliver scalable processes that reduce rework, improve quality, and accelerate project delivery.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards in root cause quality and corrective action effectiveness; analyzing and deep diving systems performance; inventing and simplifying solutions that improve installation and operational processes; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Join Team CARFAX as Onboarding Program Manager

Isn't it time you bragged about where you work? At CARFAX, we do, every day. We pride ourselves on being mission-focused on helping to grow a brand built on accuracy and integrity. We care deeply about our products and our customers. We’re more than just a company: We help millions of consumers make more-informed decisions every day. We know that our teammates are our most valuable asset, and we value a balanced life while tackling challenging projects in a fast-paced environment.

About The Role

At CARFAX, how quickly and consistently new hires reach productivity is a direct revenue imperative — and the Onboarding Program Manager owns that outcome. You’ll design, build, and run structured onboarding for every revenue-generating and customer-facing team in the DBU: Sales (Field, Strategic, and Inside), Customer Care, and Service/Account Management.

A central goal is consistency. Today, onboarding varies depending on which manager a new hire reports to — you’ll create a standard, repeatable approach within each team (so every Field Sales director ramps new reps the same way) while keeping each team’s distinct needs intact. You’ll facilitate monthly in-person sessions at CARFAX’s Reston, VA headquarters, build the content new hires rely on, and partner closely with internal teams to ensure new hires receive the most relevant content.

At CARFAX, we believe in the power of teamwork and value in-person interactions so that we can collaborate and thrive together. This position will require 3-4 days a week in our Virginia office subject to change with future business needs.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own onboarding end-to-end for all DBU teams. Own the new hire experience for Sales (Field, Strategic, and Inside), Customer Care, and Service/Account Management, building programs that reflect each team’s distinct roles, tools, and success metrics. Assess the existing program, keep what works, and build on the rest.
Standardize onboarding within each team. Create a consistent, repeatable approach for each team so every new hire gets the same experience regardless of their manager — while preserving the meaningful differences between teams.
Design and own role-specific pathways and milestones. Build structured learning journeys for each role, from pre-boarding through full ramp. You own how long onboarding runs and what “ready” means, anchoring each pathway to clear milestones so you can track progress and intervene early when someone falls behind.
Facilitate monthly onboarding sessions and role-plays at HQ. Lead structured, high-energy in-person sessions at Reston HQ each month — role-plays, skills practice, objection handling, and live dealer simulations. The best programs are practice-heavy, not information-dumps, so reps build skill through repetition and feedback before their first live call.
Create and maintain high-quality onboarding content. Own all onboarding materials — learning paths, playbooks, decks, quick-reference guides, role-play scripts, and certifications — polished, current, and built for how people actually learn. Requires strong PowerPoint and content-creation skills.
Partner closely with the Sales Enablement Lead. Make the handoff from onboarding to ongoing enablement seamless — one continuous journey, not a cliff. Your programs should set up their work, not duplicate it.
Measure what matters and continuously improve. Track time-to-productivity, ramp time by role, cohort trends, manager satisfaction, and new-hire feedback, and use them to decide what to keep, cut, or rebuild. Completion rates are a baseline, not a success metric.
Collaborate cross-functionally and leverage experts. Partner with HR on pre-boarding, Marketing and Product on product knowledge, and RevOps on milestones and KPIs. Maintain a network of internal SMEs who keep programs accurate, making their involvement easy rather than a burden.

Required

What we’re looking for:

5+ years of experience designing, building, and leading structured onboarding programs — ideally across multiple teams or roles within a single organization.
Demonstrated success reducing time-to-productivity and improving new hire ramp outcomes, with data to support it.
A track record of standardizing programs across managers or locations to reduce variance in the new-hire experience.
Experience taking an existing program and improving it — assessing what’s working, keeping what is, and rebuilding what isn’t — rather than only building from a blank page.
Strong live facilitation skills — you are at your best in front of a room, leading a role-play, running a skills certification, or coaching a new hire in real time.
Exceptional content-creation skills, including the ability to build polished, well-designed learning materials, onboarding decks, and training presentations in PowerPoint (or equivalent tools) that are clear, compelling, and field-ready.
Experience building role-specific, milestone-based onboarding pathways tailored to distinct job functions.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously — this role serves multiple teams with different cycles, content needs, and go-live moments.
Ability to travel up to 15% of the time to support field team onboarding, regional events, and key team milestones.
Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (HR, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Marketing) to build programs that are accurate, aligned, and well-supported.

Preferred

Local to the Northern Virginia/DC metro area and able to work from CARFAX’s Reston, VA headquarters on a regular basis — monthly onboarding sessions are in-person, and proximity to HQ makes a meaningful difference in this role.
Automotive industry or automotive technology experience; understanding how dealerships operate and how CARFAX’s products serve them is a genuine advantage.
Experience supporting onboarding across a blend of commercial roles — sales, customer service, and account/service management.
Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), content management tools, and conversation intelligence platforms (e.g., Gong, Chorus).
Experience with a revenue enablement platform (e.g., Allego, Highspot, Seismic) and a CRM (preferably Salesforce).

What’s In It For You

Competitive compensation, benefits and generous time-off policies
4-Day summer work weeks and a winter holiday break
401(k) / DCPP matching
Annual bonus program
Casual, dog-friendly, and innovative office spaces.

Don’t Just Take Our Word For It

13x VA Best Places to Work
12x Top Workplaces in Washington (Presented by The Washington Post and WTOP)
9x Washingtonian Great Place to Work
5x USA Today Top Workplaces
5x St. Louis Post-Dispatch Best Places to Work

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including geographic location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

Carfax is committed to providing competitive compensation that reflects local market conditions and individual contributions. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for incentive compensation, long-term incentives, and a comprehensive benefits package, where applicable.

About CARFAX And S&P Global Mobility

S&P Global has recently announced the intent to separate our Mobility Segment into a standalone public company.

CARFAX, part of S&P Global Mobility, helps millions of people every day confidently shop, buy, service and sell used cars with innovative solutions powered by CARFAX vehicle history information. The expert in vehicle history since 1984, CARFAX provides exclusive services like CARFAX Used Car Listings, CARFAX Car Care, CARFAX History-Based Value and the flagship CARFAX® Vehicle History Report™ to consumers and the automotive industry. CARFAX owns the world’s largest vehicle history database and is nationally recognized as a top workplace by The Washington Post and Glassdoor.com. Shop, Buy, Service, Sell – Show me the CARFAX™. jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Aug 29, 2026

Amazon is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to support the Amazon Logistics North America (AMZL NA) Engineering team, part of Amazon's Last Mile organization. The Last Mile team helps get customer packages from delivery stations to a customer's doorstep.

This is a unique opportunity to own high-impact engineering programs and mechanisms that advance the intelligence and reliability of our last mile business. We are looking for an individual who has experience creating scalable, data-driven solutions to complex reliability and engineering problems. In this role, you will be responsible for driving engineering program governance, compliance reporting, data analytics, and documentation systems that enable leadership visibility, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence across a portfolio of automation and electrical infrastructure projects.

You will build and maintain the mechanisms that keep our engineering organization running at the highest standard—from automated dashboards and compliance reporting to documentation platforms and stakeholder coordination. You will partner with field engineers, electrical contractors, supply chain teams, and operations leaders to deliver scalable processes that reduce rework, improve quality, and accelerate project delivery.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards in root cause quality and corrective action effectiveness; analyzing and deep diving systems performance; inventing and simplifying solutions that improve installation and operational processes; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

Design and maintain automated reporting pipelines and performance dashboards (e.g., equipment health trends, failure rates, system uptime) that provide leadership with real-time visibility into program health and enable data-driven decisions
Translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, supporting weekly business reviews and program prioritization
Build and maintain AI-powered compliance tools that aggregate multi-source data (invoices, training records, action items) into consolidated weekly leadership reports
Manage multiple concurrent engineering projects (electrical, automation, MHE) across the NA delivery station network, coordinating timelines and deliverables with external contractors
Track project milestones and completion metrics; identify process gaps through root cause analysis and implement corrective actions that reduce rework and accelerate project delivery
Own weekly organizational compliance reporting on a strict cadence; monitor metrics including training completion, invoice accuracy, and Correction of Error action item closure
Administer engineering documentation platforms and develop SOPs that standardize processes across the network; drive document governance including version control, review cycles, and user enablement
Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Operations, RME, and external contractors; facilitate status meetings and manage escalations from field engineers through senior leadership

A day in the life

No two days look alike in this role. You will move fluidly between analyzing performance data and building dashboards, facilitating cross-functional alignment meetings, and designing scalable process improvements that eliminate rework across the network. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution—architecting a new reporting mechanism one hour and removing barriers for field teams the next. You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership of problems before they are assigned, and find energy in the variety of challenges that come with supporting and driving measurable impact across a fast-moving engineering organization operating at Amazon scale.

About The Team

Our diverse team of engineers and program managers owns the full lifecycle, from firm engineering through project execution to final customer hand-off. We are customer-obsessed, data-driven, and never satisfied with the status quo. We capture lessons learned, incorporate them into our mechanisms, and raise the quality bar with each iteration. Our approach to growth is holistic—we continually learn, develop, and expand expertise across the organization, leveraging subject matter knowledge on a global scale. Collaboration is at our core; we are a true team that supports, challenges, and leverages each other's strengths to deliver on the Customer Promise every day.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology
Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases
Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
3+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology
Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings, or experience developing MOPs and SWMS for planned works
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification

What You Will Do

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with safety. It’s the constant that empowers people to confidently move forward. It can fill a flight or sell out a stadium. It can care for a patient or graduate a class.

As a global leader in public safety and enterprise security, we create and connect the technologies that help to keep people safe where they live, learn, work and play. Our integrated technology ecosystem unifies critical communications, video security and access control, and command center software, enabling collaboration in more powerful ways.

At Motorola Solutions, we’re ushering in a new era in public safety and security. Bring your passion, potential and talents to a career that matters.

The Security Project Manager is responsible for the controlled delivery of security-related initiatives, projects and workstreams across Flutter CEE within the CIO delivery governance model.

The role ensures security initiatives are delivered with clear scope, ownership, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholder alignment, governance cadence and transparent reporting. It provides hands-on project management discipline while ensuring that security outcomes are coordinated with technology, operations, architecture, product engineering, business and leadership stakeholders.

The Security Project Manager works under the Head of Delivery and partners closely with IS Security, Technology Service & Operations, Architecture, AI & Innovation, Performance Intelligence, CTO delivery teams and business stakeholders. The role ensures security delivery is treated as managed CIO delivery work, not only as a dependency or consultation activity.

The role is accountable for project execution control for assigned security initiatives. It is not accountable for final security policy ownership, security risk acceptance, architecture standards, budget governance or technical implementation ownership; those areas remain with the relevant accountable functions.

Material delivery risks, unresolved dependencies, scope conflicts, governance exceptions, resource gaps or delivery blockers are escalated to the Head of Delivery as the first formal escalation path.

Key Responsibilities

Security Project Delivery & Execution

Own day-to-day project management for assigned security initiatives, ensuring delivery is structured, transparent and aligned to agreed CIO priorities.
Create and maintain project plans, milestones, workstream plans, action logs, RAID, dependency maps, status reports and closure artefacts.
Ensure each initiative has clear scope, sponsor, delivery owner, accountable stakeholders, delivery approach, acceptance criteria, expected outcomes and reporting cadence.
Apply appropriate delivery methods based on initiative size, risk, complexity and delivery model, including agile, waterfall or hybrid approaches.
Challenge unclear scope, weak ownership, unrealistic timelines, missing dependencies and unmanaged risks in a constructive and professional way.

Security Workstream Governance

Ensure security initiatives and security workstreams follow agreed CIO delivery governance, PMO standards, reporting requirements and escalation routes.
Track security milestones, control readiness, implementation dependencies, decision points and evidence requirements through the project lifecycle.
Ensure delivery governance is practical, decision-focused and proportionate to project risk, complexity and business impact.
Maintain clear records of key decisions, approvals, exceptions, assumptions, dependencies and delivery commitments.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Own stakeholder coordination for assigned security projects across IS Security, Technology Service & Operations, Architecture, CTO Product Engineering, AI Innovation Hub, Performance Intelligence, business teams, vendors and leadership stakeholders.
Maintain stakeholder maps, communication plans, meeting cadence, decision forums and escalation paths for assigned initiatives.
Provide clear, timely and audience-appropriate communication on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions required and delivery confidence.
Manage expectations proactively where scope, timing, resources, dependencies or priority sequencing changes.

RAID, Dependency & Escalation Management

Identify, document and actively manage risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies across assigned security initiatives.
Ensure risks and blockers are assigned to clear owners, reviewed regularly and escalated before they materially affect delivery outcomes.
Escalate material delivery risks, unresolved blockers, ownership gaps, dependency conflicts, governance breaches or resource constraints to the Head of Delivery with context, impact, options and recommendation.
Maintain an integrated view of dependencies between security, infrastructure, architecture, product engineering, operations, vendors and business stakeholders.

Cross-Delivery Coordination

Coordinate security delivery contributions for initiatives that span CIO, CTO and Chief Strategy Officer delivery teams.
Where security is a contributor, ensure security commitments, deliverables, risks, decisions, dependencies and readiness criteria are clearly planned and represented in the lead delivery plan.
Where security or CIO is leading, manage the delivery cadence, workstream coordination, dependency control, status reporting and escalation for assigned initiatives.
Support formal intake by clarifying security scope, impact, complexity, stakeholder groups, dependencies and delivery route.

Operational Readiness, Transition & Closure

Ensure implementation readiness, operational acceptance, support handover, documentation, training needs and post-implementation activities are planned and tracked.
Coordinate with Technology Service & Operations, IS Security operations, vendors and support teams to ensure delivered security capabilities are supportable and sustainable.
Support project closure, KPI tracking, lessons learned, delivery retrospectives and continuous improvement actions.
Ensure residual risks, open actions, support obligations and ownership transitions are documented before closure.

AI-First Delivery Operations

Apply AI-first thinking to improve delivery planning, status preparation, RAID summaries, meeting outputs, action tracking, stakeholder communication and PMO knowledge management.
Use AI-supported delivery practices responsibly, maintaining accuracy, transparency, data protection, security expectations and human accountability for judgement and decisions.
Share practical improvements and lessons learned with the Head of Delivery and Delivery Forum where relevant.

Required Experience

5+ years of experience in project management, delivery management, technology delivery, security delivery or transformation delivery roles.
Experience managing technology projects involving security controls, risk reduction, compliance readiness, operational readiness or cross-functional security workstreams.
Strong understanding of project governance, delivery lifecycle management, planning, RAID, dependency management, status reporting and escalation practices.
Experience operating in matrix environments where business, technology, security, operations, product, architecture and vendor teams contribute to shared outcomes.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, planning and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate complex security and technical delivery topics into clear plans, risks, options, actions and decisions required.
Experience using delivery tooling such as AHA, Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet or equivalent.
Ability to challenge unclear scope, weak ownership, unmanaged risks and poor delivery discipline constructively.

experience in gaming, betting, fintech, digital platforms, regulated technology or multi-market environments.

Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

The Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful delivery of HVAC Service & Modernisation projects, managing the full project lifecycle from planning through to completion. Working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams, the role ensures projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards while meeting contractual obligations. The Project Manager also drives strong commercial outcomes, maintains compliance with WHS and Carrier standards, and delivers an exceptional customer experience that supports Carrier's operational and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

Lead the planning, coordination, and successful delivery of HVAC projects from initiation through to completion.
Develop and manage project schedules, scopes, resources, and delivery plans to achieve project objectives.
Manage subcontractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.
Monitor project financial performance, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, variations, and profitability.
Ensure compliance with WHS legislation, Carrier safety standards, and customer-specific safety requirements while promoting a strong safety culture.
Oversee project documentation, commissioning, handover, and project close-out in line with Carrier quality standards.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, consultants, engineering teams, and sales to ensure effective communication and project success.
Provide regular project status updates, commercial reporting, and technical support to stakeholders while identifying and mitigating project risks.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

3–5 years' project management experience within the HVAC, mechanical services, or building services industry.
Strong technical knowledge of HVAC systems, installation practices, and commissioning processes.
Proven ability to successfully manage multiple concurrent projects, ensuring delivery on time and within budget.
Experience in budget management, cost control, financial reporting, and commercial decision-making.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills with customers, contractors, and internal teams.
Demonstrated commitment to workplace health, safety, and regulatory compliance across project sites.
Strong organisational, planning, problem-solving, and analytical capabilities with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Tertiary qualification in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline, with experience delivering upgrade, modernisation, or infrastructure projects highly regarded.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way .

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

and looking for a B2B Sales Project Manager
to join us in Riga.

and created over 5,000 workplaces
in Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia.

• Fluency in Latvian and a good command of English

will be an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

, depending on experience and sales results

Full-time, on-site

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.
As a Staff IT Technical Program Manager on the IT Operations team, you'll own and drive eDiscovery and information governance programs across Coinbase. Embedded with cross-functional leadership, you'll serve as the connective tissue between domain experts and engineering teams, identifying automation opportunities, prototyping solutions with AI and workflow tooling, and driving adoption across the organization. You'll lead the technical strategy behind defensible eDiscovery processes and entity-specific retention capabilities, ensuring Coinbase meets its regulatory obligations at scale.
What you’ll do:

Own the end-to-end strategy and execution for eDiscovery and information governance solutions spanning multiple business functions and enterprise platforms.
Partner with engineering teams to deliver technology programs that transform eDiscovery capabilities from hold through collection, review, and production (EDRM).
Drive the translation of regulatory and compliance requirements into actionable system configurations, policies, and controls across platforms such as Slack and Google Workspace.
Lead program timelines, dependencies, and risk escalations while maintaining audit-ready documentation including regulatory control matrices, playbooks, and SLAs.
Build and validate comprehensive test plans for eDiscovery controls and information governance tooling to ensure defensibility and compliance.

Required Skills and Experience:

5+ years of experience in technical program management, information governance, eDiscovery, or regulatory compliance.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional compliance programs with multiple dependencies in a dynamic environment.
Working knowledge of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) and hands-on experience with eDiscovery tooling (e.g., Relativity, Nuix, Google Vault, Onna).
Experience translating regulatory requirements into enterprise system controls and configurations across collaboration and productivity platforms.
Proven ability to build roadmaps, manage dependencies, and drive programs independently with minimal day-to-day direction.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

King & Spalding is a leading global law firm with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the seamless delivery of legal services. We harness innovative technology and exceptional talent to meet the complex needs of our clients in a fast-paced and dynamic legal landscape.

The Program Manager is a delivery partner and governance steward accountable for the end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives from intake through execution to steady-state ownership. The Program Manager leads individual high-impact projects or coordinates a program of related projects that must move together to achieve a shared business outcome.

This role operates at the intersection of delivery discipline and strategic advisory — managing complexity and ambiguity while enforcing accountability and governance across every phase of the project lifecycle. The Program Manager partners with project sponsors, functional leaders, and senior leadership to translate approved initiatives into executable plans, proactively manage risk and change, and ensure outcomes align with firm objectives. As a trusted advisor to the business, this role provides consistent governance, transparency, and execution discipline across all assigned projects, contributing to overall portfolio health, leadership confidence, and predictable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Intake & Initiation

Lead assigned initiatives from formal intake through project closure, ensuring alignment with firm priorities and governance expectations.
Partner with sponsors and functional leaders to define project goals, success measures, scope boundaries, assumptions, and high-level risks prior to execution.
Lead cross-functional teams delivering initiatives that may include business process change, software implementations or upgrades, technology deployment, vendor engagement, or organizational transformation.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, budget, and change impacts.
Ensure disciplined execution across all project phases, including kickoff, planning, execution, stabilization, and transition to operational ownership.

Delivery & Governance

Demonstrate strong financial acumen, effectively managing project budgets, forecasts, and financial controls to ensure initiatives are delivered within approved funding.
Maintain accurate, current project data to support portfolio-level visibility and leadership decision-making.
Prepare and present concise, decision-oriented updates for executive readouts, steering committees, and portfolio reviews — with the ability to engage and advise at the C-suite level.
Identify, monitor, and manage project risks, interdependencies, and constraints across business and technology teams.
Proactively escalate risks, issues, and decisions requiring leadership attention, providing clear recommendations and options rather than problems alone.
Lead scope, timeline, and budget changes in alignment with PMO governance expectations, ensuring impacts are assessed, documented, approved, and communicated.
Influence, negotiate, and build alignment across teams and functions to drive decisions and keep initiatives on track.
Model PMO expectations by maintaining projects that are transparent, well-governed, and portfolio-ready at all times.

Stakeholder Partnership & Organizational Change

Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to the business, ensuring initiatives align with firm growth objectives and governance frameworks.
Collaborate to ensure requirements, outcomes, and success measures are clearly defined and validated.
Work closely with Practice Enablement team to develop and implement strategies that promote stakeholder engagement and adoption, reducing delivery risk and supporting successful outcomes.
Facilitate steering committee updates, executive briefings, and cross-functional working sessions.
Proactively identify and resolve project roadblocks, interdependencies, and resource gaps.

Stabilization & Continuous Improvement

Lead stabilization and transition-to-operations activities, ensuring ownership, documentation, and readiness criteria are met before project closure.
Conduct project post-mortems, capture lessons learned, and implement improvements to PMO practices, tools, and delivery approaches.
Identify and evaluate opportunities for process improvement and contribute to the ongoing development of PMO methodologies and standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or equivalent business experience required.
PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience delivering cross-functional initiatives in a structured governance environment.
Experience managing both business-led and technology-enabled projects.
Comfortable with Agile methodologies with the ability to adapt approach based on the needs of a particular project.
Proven ability to partner effectively with senior leaders, sponsors, and C-suite stakeholders.
Experience operating within portfolio review, executive reporting, and decision-making cadences.
Background in a law firm, professional services firm, or similarly complex global organization preferred.
Strategic, analytical, and systems thinker who connects project execution to business outcomes.
Thrives in ambiguity — able to bring structure and accountability to complex, fast-moving environments while exercising sound independent judgment.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to craft and deliver executive-level messaging that is clear, concise, and decision-oriented.
Demonstrated ability to influence and negotiate across teams, functions, and seniority levels without direct authority.
Proactive risk management orientation — surfaces issues early, brings options, and drives toward resolution.
Intellectually curious, with the critical thinking to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and keep initiatives aligned and on track.
Scrupulous approach to documentation, project data integrity, and tool discipline — understands that strong governance infrastructure is what makes portfolio visibility and leadership confidence possible.
Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools; experience with platforms such as MS Project or equivalent required.

The firm offers a generous total compensation package with bonuses and raises awarded in recognition of individual merit-based performance. All full-time Business Services employees may participate in King & Spalding’s comprehensive benefit program including health and wellness plan, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts and a health savings account, a 401(k) plan, profit sharing plan, and a substantial Paid Time Off (PTO) program.

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Champions compliance by contributing to knowledge sharing across teams to build compliance capability of others.

Initiation

Drives project initiation for projects of medium complexity (e.g., multiple offerings, and/or supports projects of high complexity (e.g., tailored offerings, high visibility, high impact, market making) by delivering a workstream within a larger project/program, by driving commitment of delivery resources, assigning resources, assisting in sourcing and qualifying partner resources, and creating work breakdown structures (WBSs) with delivery team.

Contracting

Facilitates contracting process for customer and partner resources (e.g., contractors, vendors) by briefing partners, coordinating partner candidate interviews, and identifying and acclimating partner resources to the team. Supports negotiation and structuring of fixed-fee subcontractor contracts with oversight from senior colleagues. Contributes to pre-sales for medium-impact projects by articulating the business value proposition associated with the project/change and considering associated complexities and risks to ensure feasibility of commercial offer. Participates in review of proposed scope and assists in developing Statement of Work (SOW), Work Breakdown Structures (WBSs), estimates, preliminary risk assessments, etc.

Planning

Develops detailed project management plan to drive predictable delivery for projects of medium complexity or supports senior colleagues in projects of high complexity, leveraging existing materials and experience to drive scope, resources, and Microsoft project schedule in alignment and collaboration with customer plan. Ensures use of baselining, resource load balancing, and application of work effort, dependency management, contingency planning, and utilization of software (e.g., Timeline).

Establishes clear expectations and accountabilities (e.g., reconfirm scope, Responsible-Accountable-Consulted-Informed matrix) with all project team members (e.g., consultants) and stakeholders for teams of medium complexity by leading internal and external kick-off meetings (e.g., sales to delivery handoff, formal kick-off meetings). Proactively engages broad set of internal and external stakeholders, including those who are impacted by project scope/outcome, but not directly involved (e.g., Enterprise Operating Unit, India Global Delivery, customer stakeholders) and engages subject matter experts in holistic planning activities, including team validation.

Monitoring and Controlling

Orchestrates and oversees a broad range of project metrics on midsize to large projects with high visibility (e.g., Vice President-level). Proactively ensures adherence to key performance indicators (KPIs) and provides strategic direction to drive success throughout project lifecycle.

Proactively manages risks and issues within projects of standard complexity, leveraging technical knowledge and previous experience to evaluate risks, perform qualitative analyses (e.g., probability, impact, urgency), create risk management plans, establish processes, and work with cross-functional groups and leaders to mitigate identified risks. Contributes to recovery efforts and ensures tools are updated. Manages issue closure as a high priority.

Ensures timely completion and quality of deliverables (e.g., documents) and tracking of agreed upon metrics for projects of standard complexity by applying quality management techniques (e.g., benchmarking, interviews) for collecting data. Uses analyses to identify solutions to systemic issues.

Discusses and confirms Microsoft change control processes at kickoff with customer. Anticipates changes and proactively addresses by probing to ensure change can happen smoothly early in the process. Tests process before initiating formal change.

Manages finances for projects with mid-size to large scopes and budgets by balancing funding and resources across workstreams, performing analyses, and leveraging cost management experience and expertise. Aims to reduce cost and improve delivery margin without impact to quality or customer experience and understands impact of decisions on the broader business (e.g., profits and losses [P&L], accrual-based accounting).

Manages stakeholder communications on project health, issues, and financial performance for mid-size to large deals throughout entire project lifecycle, tailoring communications to the audience. Tracks and maintains customer deliverables.

Closure

Drives timely project closure by ensuring completion of project sign off tasks (e.g., system closeout updates, deletion of customer data, Deliverable Acceptance Form). Drives incremental process improvement by reflecting on and sharing lessons learned across teams, creating and suggesting improvements to intellectual property (IP), providing feedback to managers on team member performance, and conducting closeout interviews with team members.

Applies advanced knowledge across project management principle areas to execution and delivery, contributes at local team-wide level to share knowledge and support others, serves as a mentor to less experienced colleagues to grow identified skill gaps, and participates in cross-border mentoring and peer alignment to share lessons learned on challenging projects.

Business Growth

Demonstrates accountability for the financial health of a project or program (e.g., revenue attainment, accurate forecasting, cost management, and utilization, skills, and capacity planning). Identifies opportunities to accelerate and drive consumption and delivery. Owns and drives backlog risk management. Drives incremental business on top of existing projects and programs through next step proposals, conducts customer discussions related to next stage proposal (NSP) and other opportunities. Engages in the pursuit cycle to ensure deals are structured appropriately. Supports and contributes to rhythm of business (ROB) and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) forecasting.

Looks for or creates opportunities to maximize timely cloud consumption through current deliveries. Identifies new opportunities with customers and facilitates follow up conversations with customers on Consumption both strategically and operational, and to accelerate delivery or prevent delivery delays.

Other

Embody our culture and values

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent experience. MBA preferred. Fluency in AI and its possibilities would be a preferred plus.

Experience delivering Azure AI, OpenAI, Copilot, and Data & Analytics solutions at scale. Ability to engage technically with Architects and Engineers on AI architecture trade-offs. Understanding of Responsible AI, enterprise AI risk, security, and compliance considerations.

Qualifications

new_jobs.title: Circuit Delivery Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Position Summary : 
The Circuit Delivery Project Manager / Team Lead is a senior delivery leader responsible for managing complex telecommunications deployments and serving as the primary escalation point for the Circuit Delivery organization. This role oversees the successful delivery of Broadband, Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), LEO satellite, Fixed Wireless, and 5G wireless services across domestic and international locations.

 The Project Manager / Team Lead manages circuit delivery projects from order initiation through installation, testing, turn-up, and closeout while coordinating directly with customers, carriers, engineering teams, internal stakeholders, and delivery coordinators. The role combines hands-on project management with team leadership, carrier escalation, risk management, process governance, and coaching.

 The successful candidate must bring meaningful telecommunications and carrier-services experience. This position is intended for an experienced professional who understands carrier ordering and provisioning processes, can navigate carrier organizations and portals, understands common delivery risks, and can quickly determine the appropriate escalation path when an order is delayed or at risk. Experience working for or with major carriers such as AT&T, Verizon, Lumen, Comcast Business, Spectrum Enterprise, Cox Business, Zayo, or comparable providers is highly desirable.

Core Responsibilities : 

Lead complex circuit and wireless service deployments from order through final turn-up and closeout.

Serve as the primary escalation point for carrier delivery issues, missed milestones, construction delays, provisioning problems, access challenges, and customer-impacting risks.

Direct and prioritize the work of Circuit Delivery Coordinators supporting assigned projects and ensure appropriate workload distribution.

Establish and maintain project schedules, milestone plans, dependencies, risks, action items, and customer commitments.

Manage multiple domestic and international carrier relationships and drive providers toward committed delivery dates.

Review carrier order status, portal information, provisioning milestones, and exceptions to determine project health and required action.

Validate that carrier solutions and order details align with customer requirements, including service type, bandwidth, location, demarcation, delivery method, and requested dates.

Lead customer and internal status meetings for complex or high-visibility deployments and communicate clear recovery plans when milestones are at risk.

Partner with engineering and technical teams on service design, demarcation, equipment requirements, testing, activation, and turn-up.

Ensure required delivery documentation is complete, accurate, and retained in accordance with company standards.

Identify systemic carrier performance issues and recurring delivery bottlenecks; develop corrective actions and escalate trends to leadership.

Establish escalation paths and maintain productive relationships with carrier account teams, provisioning groups, construction teams, dispatch, and support organizations.

Coach and mentor Delivery Coordinators on milestone management, carrier communication, documentation, escalation practices, and delivery standards.

Review aging orders and project health metrics and proactively intervene before customer commitments are missed.

Drive continuous improvement of carrier delivery processes, templates, reporting, and operating procedures.

Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with customer SLAs, internal standards, contractual commitments, and applicable operational procedures.

Carrier & Telecom Expertise : 

Demonstrated working knowledge of carrier ordering, provisioning, construction, dispatch, installation, testing, and service activation processes.

Experience managing services such as Broadband, DIA, Ethernet, Point-to-Point, Fixed Wireless, 5G/LTE, and/or LEO satellite services.

Ability to work effectively with multiple carriers simultaneously and understand differences in carrier processes, portals, terminology, and escalation paths.

Experience navigating carrier organizations and escalating issues through account teams, provisioning, construction, engineering, dispatch, and leadership channels.

Ability to interpret carrier order information and recognize inconsistencies or risks that may not be obvious to a less experienced coordinator.

Experience with domestic and international service delivery is strongly preferred.

Leadership & Project Management Expectations : 

Own project outcomes rather than simply tracking tasks; actively drive stakeholders toward resolution.

Establish clear accountability for each milestone, action item, dependency, and escalation.

Provide direction to Coordinators while remaining accountable for overall project health and customer commitments.

Maintain executive-ready status reporting for high-priority, complex, or at-risk deployments.

Develop recovery plans when delivery dates are missed or carrier performance creates project risk.

Use project management best practices to manage scope, schedule, risk, communications, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

Standardize delivery practices and help build repeatable processes that can scale with increasing circuit volume.

Qualifications : 

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Project Management, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

5+ years of project management, telecommunications, carrier services, network delivery, or related experience.

Significant hands-on experience with telecom/carrier service delivery is required.

PMP certification preferred.

Experience working for, with, or closely alongside major telecom/carrier organizations such as AT&T, Verizon, Lumen, Comcast Business, Spectrum Enterprise, Cox Business, Zayo, or comparable providers strongly preferred.

Proven experience managing multiple concurrent telecom deployments and customer commitments.

Strong understanding of carrier portals, ordering systems, provisioning workflows, and delivery milestones.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, customers, carriers, engineers, and delivery teams.

Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and escalation-management skills.

Intermediate or greater proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, and project management tools.

Preferred Experience : 

Experience leading a carrier services delivery or circuit provisioning team.

Experience with enterprise multi-site deployments, national rollouts, or international telecommunications programs.

Experience with SD-WAN, Internet, DIA, Ethernet, Broadband, wireless, fixed wireless, or LEO deployments.

Experience establishing carrier scorecards, KPIs, delivery metrics, or escalation processes.

Experience building or improving telecom delivery processes and operational standards.

PMP certification or comparable formal project management training.

Success Factors : 

Recognized as the person who can get a difficult carrier order moving when normal processes fail.

Strong carrier relationships and the credibility to escalate issues effectively.

Balances urgency and customer service with disciplined project management.

Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable managing a large volume of concurrent work.

Leads through accountability, coaching, and clear communication.

Quickly identifies the root cause of delivery problems and develops practical recovery plans.

Creates structure and consistency across the Circuit Delivery team while maintaining flexibility for customer-specific requirements.

Role Differentiation
The Project Manager / Team Lead is expected to bring the telecom and carrier knowledge required to lead complex deployments and resolve escalations. Unlike the Coordinator role, prior carrier-services experience is a core requirement for this position. The Coordinator can be developed through structured training and hands-on experience; the Team Lead must be able to step into an active carrier escalation, understand the underlying issue, identify the correct carrier path, and provide direction to the team.

This is a hybrid role requiring you to work three office-based days a week.

The role focuses on producing accurate internal fund valuations for use within the DIU. The team covers various fund types (Credit, Fixed-Income, LDI, Multi-Asset, CCF) and we work closely with Portfolio Managers as our valuation data is used for portfolio management, trade-sizing and rebalancing. Our valuations are additionally used to control and oversee Administrator valuations, external managers and for performance reporting.

We will count on you to:

Produce valuations: Accurate and timely delivery is fundamental to allow portfolio managers to trade.
Understand a wide variety of instruments: We value a multitude of instruments including, but not limited to: Fixed Income, Listed Futures and Options, OTC Swaps, FX Forwards, Hedge Funds & UCITs, Private Equity.
Validate Performance Contribution: Instrument level performance contribution and relative contribution. We need to be comfortable explaining performance to Portfolio Managers and external parties.
Oversee Fund Administrators: The accuracy of our internal data is crucial to oversee and sign-off on the Administrator fund valuations and NAVs as official books and records for our clients.
Work as part of a team: processes are rotated across the team according to capacity and we need to be able to work dynamically as part of a team to meet our deliverables.

What you need to have:

Affinity with Investments. You do not need expertise & experience in all financial instruments listed above, but a desire to learn is important.
Experience in a middle/back office role of an asset or risk manager, custodian or fund administrator.
Strong communication skills (verbal, written and interpersonal)
Energy and enthusiasm.
Intermediate to strong knowledge of Excel.
Organisational skills and a calm and logical approach to meeting multiple deadlines.

To be part of a fast growing and ever-changing part of the Mercer business. The DIU is expected to continue to increase AUM significantly in the coming years.
Exposure to a wide variety of instruments and fund types and an opportunity to work closely with Portfolio Managers.
Exposure to large scale projects: such as the coming migration to CRIMS and a standardised IBOR across the business.
